turns.question: Do we sell more at weekends? Between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, what was our average daily revenue on Saturdays and Sundays, and on the other days?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric or weekday dimension that gives average daily revenue split into weekend and weekday days, so I cannot give those two averages. The closest metric is Revenue (EUR), which I can break down by day for 2026-08-17 to 2026-09-27 (42 days). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
